test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which initiative does the development of Vikram 3201 and Kalpana 3201 in 2025 align with?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Make in India campaign**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Make in India** campaign was launched by the Government of India on **25th September 2014** to encourage companies to manufacture their products in India and boost domestic manufacturing.
 
• The initiative aims to transform India into a global manufacturing hub by promoting investment, innovation, skill development, and infrastructure development.
 
• It focuses on 25 key sectors, including electronics, automobiles, defense manufacturing, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and textiles.
 
• Development of products like **Vikram 3201 and Kalpana 3201** aligns with the campaign's objective of fostering indigenous design, development, and production.
 
• The campaign contributes to the reduction of import dependency and strengthens India's self-reliance in manufacturing and technological advancements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Digital India campaign:** A flagship initiative launched by the Government of India in 2015 to make India digitally empowered in technology and governance.
 
• **Start-Up India initiative:** A program initiated in 2016 to promote entrepreneurship and support startups with funding, mentorship, and tax benefits.
 
• **Smart City Mission:** Launched in 2015, it aims to develop 100 smart cities across India with improved urban infrastructure and technology-driven solutions.
 
• **Self-Reliant India (Atmanirbhar Bharat):** A campaign launched in 2020 to boost local manufacturing, reduce import dependency, and promote a self-sufficient economy.
 
• **Manufacturing Sector Importance:** Manufacturing is critical for economic growth, employment generation, and technological innovation, contributing significantly to India's GDP.
